column4: Visit note | 2026-07-26 03:30 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Zakia Miah, 66, female. Mrs. Miah reports feeling dizzy with a spinning sensation and nausea whenever she looks up. She mentions this began after a viral cold in Kamrangirchar. She works as a madrasa teacher. She denies headache, weakness, or ear discharge. On examination: Dix-Hallpike test positive on the left side, BP 113/83 mmHg, pulse 76 bpm, weight 56 kg. Cranial nerves are intact. Assessment: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to get up slowly from bed, avoid sudden head movements, and repeat the Epley manoeuvre at home as shown. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2026-07-26 04:30 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Rezaul Awal, 80, male. Mr. Awal describes experiencing dizziness when looking up along with nausea and a spinning feeling. He notes this started after bumping his head on a rickshaw hood in Noakhali. He is a homemaker. He denies visual disturbances, numbness, or fainting. On examination: Dix-Hallpike test positive on the left side, BP 117/72 mmHg, pulse 74 bpm, weight 56 kg. Neurological examination is otherwise normal. Assessment: Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to get up slowly from bed, avoid sudden head movements, and repeat the Epley manoeuvre at home as shown. Follow-up in 2 weeks.
